amendments_add.name: Orchid bark
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Fir or pine bark. Chunky and airy; breaks down and packs down over a year or two.

amendments_add.name: Coco coir
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Chunks are airy; ground coir holds more water. Rinse well: some is salty.

amendments_add.name: Horticultural charcoal
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Light and airy; does not break down.

amendments_add.name: Horticultural pumice
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Porous stone: airy, holds a little water inside, never breaks down.

amendments_add.name: Worm castings
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Gentle food and holds water; use a small share.

amendments_add.name: Horticultural perlite
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Very light, opens a mix; floats when watered. Also used on its own for semi-hydro.

amendments_add.name: Horticultural vermiculite
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Holds a lot of water; the opposite of perlite in a mix.

amendments_add.name: Clay pebbles (LECA)
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Fired clay balls for semi-hydro: they wick water up from a reservoir and never break down. No food: the water carries it.

amendments_add.name: Sphagnum moss (long-fibre)
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Holds a lot of water but stays airy. Often a top layer on semi-hydro pots.

amendments_add.name: Peat moss
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: The base of most bagged mixes; hard to wet again once dry.

amendments_add.name: Bagged potting mix
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: As a base to add to. Most have peat or coir and a little starter food.

amendments_add.name: Lava rock (scoria)
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Like pumice but heavier and rougher.

amendments_add.name: Calcined clay
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Fired clay granules (sold for bonsai and sports turf); holds some water inside the grain.

amendments_add.name: Coarse sand or grit
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: For cacti and succulents; adds weight so tall plants do not tip. Not fine play sand.

amendments_add.name: Zeolite
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Holds nutrients and lets them go slowly; also used in semi-hydro.

amendments_add.name: Rice hulls (parboiled)
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: A perlite substitute that breaks down in about a year.

amendments_add.name: Tree fern fibre
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: For orchids and other epiphytes.

amendments_add.name: Cork
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: For orchids and epiphytes; lasts for years.

amendments_add.name: Compost or leaf mould
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: A little food and structure, like worm castings.

amendments_add.name: Slow-release fertilizer
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: A pinch, not a part: follow the label for how much per gallon of mix.

amendments_add.name: Dolomite lime
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Raises pH and adds calcium and magnesium. A little per gallon of a peat mix.

amendments_add.name: Mycorrhizal inoculant
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: Beneficial fungi for the roots; dust onto the roots or into the mix.

amendments_add.name: Pon
amendments_add.source: Claude's summary of common growing guidance (November 2026): a rough guide for comparing amendments, not measured values
amendments_add.notes: A ready semi-hydro mix of pumice, zeolite and lava.
